svg.text: Two ways to handle SOC operations at scale
Alert volume outpaces the team. There are two legitimate ways to close the gap: add people, or add machine-speed triage with humans in control.
Grow the internal SOC, or add a traditional human-led MDR:
Upside: full human judgment, an established model, no AI-trust questions.
Cost: headcount scales with alert volume; Tier-1 fatigue and churn persist.
AI agents run triage and investigation on your stack; analysts decide:

g.text: AI agents triage and investigate at machine speed
Most noise filtered before it reaches a person

svg.text: Trade-off: demand explainable decisions; verify the AI is real, not a chatbot on a legacy SIEM.
Which model fits depends on alert volume, team size, and whether autonomous triage is something you can trust and audit. The research below works through both.
